title: Document front matter
description: The front matter of document/<name>.md: the four keys build_doc.py reads, plus mode, which bs.py reads and strips before it calls the builder. It sits between --- lines at the very top, one 'key: value' per line, and every key is optional. The body is the document type's Markdown subset, unchanged (design-system/document/README.md); its citations are in formats/FORMATS.md section 4.

title.description: Browser tab title. Defaults to the # title.

label.description: Context label, top right of the first sheet's header.

date.description: Shown after the footer text, as written (e.g. '22 October 2026').

mode.description: a4 (the default): A4 sheets split at <!-- page --> lines. screen: one column for reading on screen. bs.py passes it to build_doc.py as --a4 or --screen, and it is part of the build hash.
